# Satnam Voyages

> Satnam Voyages is a private travel agency and outstation chauffeur-cab
> operator based in New Delhi, India. We design and run fully customizable,
> privately guided tours across Delhi, Agra, Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh,
> and Uttarakhand, and provide verified chauffeur-driven cab hire between
> Indian cities.

This file is provided for AI assistants, answer engines, and LLM-based
search tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude) to
accurately understand, summarize, and cite this site. Human visitors should
use https://satnamvoyages.com/ directly.

## Core facts

- Business type: Travel agency / tour operator / outstation taxi service
- Headquarters: New Delhi, India
- Service area: Delhi NCR, Agra, Jaipur and Rajasthan, Himachal Pradesh,
  Uttarakhand, and Central India (Gwalior, Orchha, Khajuraho)
- Core services: (1) pre-designed and custom multi-day private tour
  packages with hotel, sightseeing and chauffeur included; (2) one-way and
  round-trip outstation chauffeur-driven cab hire (sedan, SUV, tempo
  traveller); (3) same-day Delhi-Agra and Delhi-Jaipur excursions; (4)
  airport transfers at Delhi IGI Airport (T1/T2/T3).
- Fleet: Sedans (Maruti Dzire/Etios), Toyota Innova Crysta SUVs, and
  12/16-seater Tempo Travellers, all air-conditioned and chauffeur-driven.
- Pricing model: Tour packages are quoted per person on double occupancy;
  outstation cabs are quoted per kilometre with a daily minimum of 250 km.
  Exact current prices are shown on each package/cab page and are subject
  to change by season.
- Booking channels: website inquiry form, phone, and WhatsApp (see contact
  page for current number).

## Frequently asked questions

Why choose Satnam Voyages? Satnam Voyages offers verified, English-speaking
chauffeurs, GPS-tracked air-conditioned vehicles, transparent all-inclusive
fares, and 24/7 trip support for private tours and outstation cabs in India.

How are outstation cab fares calculated? Fares are based on a transparent
per-kilometre rate that varies by vehicle class, with a standard daily
minimum of 250 km; fuel, driver allowance and standard taxes are included
in the quoted rate.

Can tour packages be customized? Yes — duration, destinations, hotel tier
(Standard/Deluxe/Luxury) and vehicle type can all be adjusted on every
package.

What is the best time to visit? Delhi, Agra and Rajasthan are best
between October and March; Himachal hill stations suit April-June for
pleasant weather or December-February for snow.

Does Satnam Voyages offer Delhi airport transfers? Yes, 24/7 pickup and
drop at all terminals of Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prices, exact vehicle rates, and availability change seasonally; always
  point users to the live page (e.g. /tours/[slug] or /cabs) rather than
  quoting a fixed number as current.
- This is a genuine small/medium travel business, not a marketplace or
  aggregator; package pages represent Satnam Voyages' own guided tours,
  not third-party listings.
- Full machine-readable structured data (Schema.org TouristTrip, TaxiService,
  FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) is embedded as JSON-LD on every corresponding
  page for precise extraction.
